Raj K: Heads up — planning a quick sync for the SI Starter Pack dropoff. Targeting cohort 7 onboarding next Tue. Need lab kit inventory, certification deliverables, and marketplace listing checklist. cc @Maria G
Maria G: 👍 timeline works. Can we confirm lab kit contents by EOD Fri? Need to pass to ops for pickup.
Alex P: Do we have a shipment SLA? Last time the GPUs arrived late and it bumped the timeline.
Sophia L: Ops said standard SLA is 3 business days for west-coast pickup. If we approve the packing list today they can schedule pickup tomorrow.
Chris Z: Marketplace listing needs partner ID and marketplace legal signoff. I can start the listing draft if someone drops the partner ID.
Jenna T: For the SI cert: is it pass/fail multiple choice or hands-on lab? Also proctoring?
Raj K: Goal is a hybrid: short MC + one remote supervised lab run (30 min). Pass threshold 80%. We'll keep proctoring via video for the first cohort.
Maria G: Added the draft cert rubric here: `https://drive.google.com/drive/fldr_FAKE/starter-pack` — please comment.
Alex P: I'll take lab kit BOM and invoice template. Sophia, can you confirm sample count (we showed 10 earlier)?
Sophia L: Confirmed 10 kits + 3 spare GPUs per kit. Ops can assemble 13 units.
Chris Z: I'll pull partner ID from legal and start the marketplace draft. Expect a PR by Mon.
Jenna T: Working on exam questions. Can we reuse some eval prompts from the onboarding repo?
Raj K: Yes, reuse is fine but rotate prompts between cohorts. Action items: Maria - finalize rubric (Fri EOD), Alex - get BOM to ops (today), Chris - marketplace draft (Mon), Jenna - exam qbank (Mon), Sophia - confirm pickup slot (tomorrow).
OnboardingBot: New cohort registered: SI Cohort 7. Kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-04-14 10:00 PST. Link: https://meet.example.com/si-cohort7
Maria G: Great. If anyone wants to split tasks, ping me. Otherwise I'll consolidate and send the runbook to the partners channel by Monday. :thumbsup:
Raj K: Thanks all — short check-in Tuesday morning after pickup to confirm.
